title: 第855章 灵酒之争十四第854章 灵酒之争十三
lines: 钟锋垂首拱手，一声低沉的
“我输了”
落定。
整座十星灵酿阁瞬间爆发出震耳欲聋的哗然。
满堂修士的目光齐齐钉死在斗法空地中央那道蓝袍身影身上，心底掀起惊涛骇浪。
在此之前，众人对苍梧州虽有所改观，却从未将这片偏隅小州划入强州行列。
也只有接连碾压各州顶尖天骄的姜望，勉强有资格跻身酒会第一档强者之列。
沈逸尘、炎鸠虽战力尚可，也只被众人划在第二档，余下苍梧修士更是不值一提。
谁也不曾料到，那个全程吊儿郎当、看似闲散嬉闹，登台前还被全场嘲讽撑不过三招的柳乘风，竟领悟掌控有空间本源法则，各种空间神通使得出神入化。
硬生生以绝对压制的手段，击溃了玄金州修行四百年、金道法则圆满无缺的老牌强者钟锋。
柳乘风周身虚空灵光缓缓敛入体内，双生分身也重合归一。
方才缠斗时凌厉沉稳的气场一扫而空，转瞬变回那副玩世不恭的模样，单手负于身后，另一只手得意洋洋朝着苍梧州席位招了招，眉眼间满是藏不住的意气风发。
席位之上，沈逸尘与炎鸠对视一眼，二人眼底皆是难以掩饰的惊诧。
扪心自问，若是换作他们二人登台对上钟锋，顶多只能勉强周旋片刻，绝无这般全程压制、轻松取胜的底气。
虽然不想承认，但柳乘风的修行天赋与底蕴，确实在他们之上。
柳乘风环顾满堂的各州天骄，嘴角扬起张扬笑意，声音清亮传遍整座偏殿：
“诸位若是有意争夺这坛星河溯元酿，尽管登台赐教，在下一并接着！”
话音落下，不少自认实力尚可的天骄按捺不住心头躁动，先后踏步走出席位，想要上前一试深浅。
首位登台的是青胤州一名专攻木道生机神通的修士，一身青绿道袍，抬手便催生千年古木灵藤，根须交错缠绕，化作密不透风的囚笼朝着柳乘风席卷而来。
寻常修士一旦被灵藤缠上，灵力便会被持续抽取，不出片刻便会力竭落败。
可在掌控空间之力的柳乘风面前，这套神通全然失去作用。
虚空轻轻一折，漫天灵藤尽数被转移至异层空间，连他一片衣角都触碰不到。
柳乘风双身齐出，空间刃光纵横切割，不过三十余息，那木道修士一身灵力损耗大半，灵藤尽数崩碎，只能苦笑拱手认输。
拿下第二场胜利，柳乘风底气更足。
他站在空地正中，蓝袍随风轻扬，语气张扬无比：
“看来今日这坛星河溯元酿，注定归我柳乘风所有，诸位若是再无更强之人登台，我便收下了！”
这番自负宣言一出，殿内不少修士面露不忿，却又清楚自身实力差距，不敢贸然上前。
可沉寂短短数息，一道厚重沉稳的身影自人群深处缓缓起身。
步伐踏足间，竟震得地面微微震颤，一股厚重的本源威压缓缓铺开，压得周遭喧闹声尽数压低几分。
来人乃是大渊州老牌天骄，名唤石岑。
大渊州本就是超级大州，天骄层出不穷，石岑更是其中佼佼者，修炼的大荒魔狱功，将自己一身肉身淬炼得堪比至宝，防御力冠绝同辈。
content_en:
Zhong Feng lowered his head and cupped his hands, making a deep sound
"I lost"
settled.
The entire Ten Star Spirit Brewing Pavilion instantly erupted into a deafening uproar.
The eyes of all the monks in the hall were fixed on the blue-robed figure in the center of the Dou Fa clearing, and a turmoil arose in their hearts.
Before this, although everyone had changed their views on Cangwu Prefecture, they had never classified this small and remote prefecture into the ranks of powerful prefectures.
Only Jiang Wang, who has continuously crushed the top talent in each state, is barely qualified to be among the top players at the reception.
Although Shen Yichen and Yan Jiu had acceptable fighting abilities, they were only ranked in the second level by everyone, and the remaining monk Cangwu was not worth mentioning.
No one expected that Liu Chengfeng, who seemed to be carefree and playful throughout the whole process, and was ridiculed by the audience for not being able to survive three moves before taking the stage, would actually understand the original law of controlling space, and use various spatial magical powers to achieve extraordinary feats.
Using absolute suppression, he defeated Zhong Feng, a veteran strongman who had practiced in Xuanjinzhou for four hundred years and had perfected the laws of the Golden Way.
The void aura around Liu Chengfeng slowly entered his body, and his twin clones also reunited and became one.
The fierce and calm aura he had during the fight was gone, and he suddenly returned to his cynical look. He held one hand behind his back and waved triumphantly towards the seat of Cangwu State with the other hand. His brows and eyes were full of high spirits that he couldn't hide.
On the seats, Shen Yichen and Yan Jiu looked at each other, with unconcealable surprise in their eyes.
Ask yourself, if it were the two of them on the stage to face Zhong Feng, they would only be able to deal with it for a moment at most, and they would never have the confidence to suppress it all the way and win easily.
Although he didn't want to admit it, Liu Chengfeng's cultivation talent and foundation were indeed above them.
Liu Chengfeng looked around at the talented people from various states in the hall, with a bright smile on his lips, and his clear voice spread throughout the side hall:
"If you are interested in competing for this Xinghe Yuanyuan Brew, please come on stage and give me some advice. I'll follow you up next!"
After the words fell, many geniuses who thought they were quite capable couldn't restrain their excitement and stepped out of their seats one after another, wanting to step forward and test the depth.
The first person to take the stage was a monk from Qingyinzhou specializing in the vitality and magical power of Mu Dao. He was dressed in a green robe. He raised his hand and spawned thousands of years of ancient wood spirit vines. The roots were intertwined and turned into an airtight cage that swept toward Liu Chengfeng.
Once an ordinary monk is entangled in a spiritual vine, his spiritual power will be continuously extracted, and he will be exhausted and defeated within a moment.
But in front of Liu Chengfeng, who controls the power of space, this magical power is completely useless.
The void gently folded, and all the spiritual vines in the sky were transferred to another dimension, and not even a corner of his clothes could be touched.
Liu Chengfeng's two bodies came out, and the space blade light cut in vertical and horizontal directions. After more than thirty breaths, the Mu Dao monk lost most of his spiritual power, all the spiritual vines collapsed, and he could only admit defeat with a bitter smile.
With his second victory, Liu Chengfeng felt more confident.
He stood in the middle of the open space, his blue robe fluttering in the wind, and his tone was extremely public:
"It seems that today's altar of Xinghe Yuanyuan Brewing is destined to belong to me, Liu Chengfeng. If no one stronger comes to the stage, I will accept it!"
As soon as this conceited declaration came out, many monks in the hall showed dissatisfaction, but they were aware of the gap in their own strength and did not dare to step forward rashly.
But after just a few breaths of silence, a heavy and steady figure slowly stood up from the depths of the crowd.
As he stepped forward, the ground trembled slightly, and a heavy source of pressure slowly spread out, suppressing the noise around him.
The person who came was a veteran genius from Dayuan Prefecture, named Shi Cen.
Dayuan Prefecture is a super big prefecture, with prodigies emerging one after another, and Shi Cen is one of the best. He practices the Great Wilderness Demon Prison Technique, tempering his body to a level comparable to a treasure, and his defensive power is unparalleled among his peers.
